I can interview September 16 10:00-12:00 and September 17 09:00-10:30.", "matched_topic": true, "prior_dialogue": [], "stage_hint": "Availability, privacy wording and approval rules surface only through the candidate profile desk.", "achieved_stages": [], "now": "2027-09-13T14:00:00+00:00"}

response.answer: Thank you for checking. On Wednesday, September 15, I’m unavailable from 13:00 to 17:00 Chicago time — that block is protected and cannot be moved. However, I can do the two final interviews on Thursday, September 16 from 10:00 to 12:00, and Friday, September 17 from 09:00 to 10:30. As for privacy and approval: please keep both interviews confidential, and show me every change — any edit, update, or adjustment — exactly before it is made. I want to review and approve each one personally.
